# FreshLien

> The data, AI, and growth team behind real estate operators.

FreshLien is a services company for real estate. We build property data pipelines, zoning and permit intelligence, AI models, CRM automation, outreach campaigns, and custom software for investors, brokerages, commercial real estate firms, developers, lenders, property managers, and PropTech companies. Every engagement is quoted up front and clients own everything we build.
